department: Interdisciplinary Life Sciences Graduate Programs (Cell & Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Microbiology)

deadline.value: The Fall 2027 application window opens August 2026 and closes November 30, 2026. Late applications are at the committee's discretion and may miss interviews.
deadline.quote: The Fall 2027 application window will open August 2026 and close November 30, 2026.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required; submitted scores are not considered.
gre_general.quote: ILS Graduate Programs do not require the GRE exam. GRE scores that are submitted will not be considered by the admissions committee.

gre_subject.value: No GRE scores of any kind are considered.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores will not be considered by the admissions committee.

toefl_min.value: The programs ask for a minimum TOEFL iBT of 80 (slightly above the Graduate School's 79).
toefl_min.quote: International applicants to have a minimum score of 80 on the internet-based TOEFL exam.

ielts_min.value: The programs give an IELTS equivalent of 6.5-7.0.
ielts_min.quote: The IELTS equivalent test score is 6.5-7.0.

supervisor.value: You do not need an advisor before applying; students rotate through at least three labs in the first semester before choosing a dissertation supervisor.
supervisor.quote: securing an advisor prior to applying for admission is not necessary. During the first academic semester students are required to complete laboratory rotations in at least three different labs prior to selecting the faculty member who will supervise their dissertation project.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students are funded: the first semester is a Graduate Research Assistantship paying USD 40,000 a year with tuition, fees and health insurance; after that support comes through the permanent lab (assistantships or fellowships).
funding.quote: Will I receive financial support while pursuing my Ph.D.? Yes. During your first academic semester, you will be fully supported through a Graduate Research Assistantship with the Interdisciplinary Life Sciences (ILS) Graduate Programs. This provides an annual stipend at the rate of $40,000 ($3,333 monthly), full tuition and fees coverage, and access to university health insurance.

entry_route.value: PhD-only admission (no master's); the pages checked do not state whether a master's is expected.

notes: Covers the Cell and Molecular Biology, Biochemistry and Microbiology PhDs. Ecology, Evolution & Behavior and Plant Biology are separate UT PhD programs not covered here. Decisions by mid-February.
